questions.q: Regarding the recent population surge of Asiatic lions, what significant behavioral trend has been observed?

Natural dispersal of nearly 50% of the population outside protected zones
Complete relocation to a new habitat in Madhya Pradesh
questions.explain: Around half of the population has successfully ventured beyond the traditional boundaries of the Gir sanctuary. questions.q: Why do experts emphasize the need for a second free-ranging population for Asiatic lions?
options: To boost the breeding rates artificially
To facilitate cross-breeding with Bengal tigers
To mitigate the risk of catastrophic loss from single-site diseases or disasters
questions.explain: Reliance on a single geographic location is a massive ecological gamble. If a virus hits the Gir area, the entire wild population could be wiped out, which is why scientists argue that genetic security and resilience depend on establishing a separate home for the pride.

A sharp decline in domestic industrial output
Pressure from major central banks to lower interest rates
Confidence in long-term global trade stability
questions.explain: Policy-makers decided that caution is the better part of valor given the volatility in crude oil costs and West Asian tensions. Keeping rates steady helps the RBI maintain stability until the inflationary outlook becomes a bit clearer for the Indian economy.

A statutory body corporate led by a Board of Governors
